2*H_f = hole-row pitch along the BL (code: 9 rows incl. 1 dummy per slit; lenBitline = numRow*4.5*2*H_f + numRow*TRENCH_WIDTH). For staggered rows offset 80 nm, a 100-120 nm hole needs ~140 nm row pitch (nearest-neighbour 161 nm). Check vs density: 512Gb TLC 64L die = 3.98 Gb/mm2 (JSSC 2017) -> ~2.67e9 holes/layer; area/hole = 160 nm x (9*140+175)/8 nm = 28.7e3 nm2 -> ~77 mm2 array (~60% of 128.6 mm2 die) - plausible.
